abstract: A 24-year-old man presented with right scrotal swelling and was diagnosed as having a testicular cancer. A high inguinal orchiectomy was carried out. Histological examination revealed immature teratoma and yolk sac tumor of the testis. Eight months later, 2 separate metastatic lesions appeared in the lungs, both of which were removed by operation after a course of combination chemotherapy with Etoposide and Cisplatin. The histology showed one to be composed of immature teratoma, and the another of yolk sac tumor.
abstract_ja: 24歳の男性が右陰嚢の腫脹を主訴に受診し、精巣腫瘍と診断された。高位鼠径精巣摘除術が施行された。組織学的検査で、精巣の未熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍が認められた。8か月後、肺に2つの別個の転移病変が出現した。エトポシドとシスプラチンによる併用化学療法を行った後、両病変を手術で切除した。組織学的に、一方は未熟奇形腫、他方は卵黄嚢腫瘍からなることが示された。
